coverage.concept: structural refusal as execution prevention (commit-blocking guard)
coverage.note: DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE. The category's structural refusal PREVENTS execution at the commit boundary (a guard role). NOUS is a monitor: it refuses to PRODUCE a governed attestation on ambiguity and can record a non-conformant verdict, but it does not interpose in the execution path to block the commit. Enforcement, if any, belongs to the operator's surrounding system acting on NOUS evidence.
Same monitor-not-guard boundary: NOUS evidences at the commit boundary; it does not gate it.

honest_boundary: This profile EVIDENCES which runtime-governance concepts NOUS evidence types discharge; it does NOT PROVE those concepts are correctly implemented. A future GCA signature would evidence authorship and integrity of this coverage claim, not conformance. 'proves' is reserved for the Z3/Farkas legs. NOUS is a monitor, not a guard.
